cues.en: Instructor: As you know, I am a huge, huge fan of data visualization.
cues.zh: 講師：你知道，我非常、非常喜歡資料視覺化。

cues.en: I think visualizing data is the most important way to understand your data.
cues.zh: 我認為，把資料視覺化是理解資料最重要的方式。

cues.en: Arguably, it's even more important than inferential statistics to get F values and P values and T values and so on.
cues.zh: 甚至可以說，比取得 F 值、P 值、t 值等等的推論統計還重要。

cues.en: So before getting to the statistics, I wanted to do some more visualization of these data, and I thought I'd start by going back to these correlation matrices,
cues.zh: 因此，在進入統計分析之前，我想再做一些資料視覺化，先回到這些相關矩陣，

cues.en: which I've already shown before, but now I want to inspect them in a bit more detail.
cues.zh: 先前已經展示過，但現在要更仔細檢查。

cues.en: So here we have the correlation matrix of the marriage data and the correlation of the divorce data.
cues.zh: 這裡有結婚資料的相關矩陣，以及離婚資料的相關矩陣。

cues.en: Now, we've already spent some time interpreting the correlation matrix of the marriage data.
cues.zh: 我們已經花了一些時間，解讀結婚資料的相關矩陣。

cues.en: Remember, I said that it looks like the marriage rates are weakly correlated over a 30 year period, but when you actually look at the scale,
cues.zh: 記得，我說過，跨越 30 年的結婚率看起來只有弱相關，但實際看尺度時，

cues.en: they're still really strongly correlated.
cues.zh: 它們仍然高度相關。

cues.en: You know, this correlation from 2019 to 1990 is you know, it's like 0.9 or maybe even a little bit more than 0.9.
cues.zh: 2019 年與 1990 年之間的相關，大約是 0.9，甚至可能略高於 0.9。

cues.en: However, the same correlation matrix on the divorce data actually does show more diversity of correlation or more diversity of dynamics.
cues.zh: 不過，同樣的相關矩陣用在離婚資料上，確實顯示更多不同的相關程度，或更多不同的動態。

cues.en: So the correlations are weaker.
cues.zh: 因此，相關比較弱。

cues.en: Here you see the correlations across a 30 year period go down to around 0.7.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，跨越 30 年的相關降到大約 0.7。

cues.en: It's still pretty, you know, it's a pretty strong correlation, but it's a lot weaker than the correlation of the marriage data over time.
cues.zh: 這仍然是相當強的相關，但比結婚資料隨時間的相關弱很多。

cues.en: So there's something going on with all these different states where the rates of marriages across the different states over time is really similar, whereas the divorce rates
cues.zh: 所以，各州之間有某種情況：各州的結婚率隨時間變化的模式很相似，但離婚率

cues.en: are changing over time.
cues.zh: 則會隨時間改變。

cues.en: Now, I don't really know how to interpret that.
cues.zh: 我其實不知道該如何解讀。

cues.en: You would need, you know, a sociologist or a modern historian to help us make sense of that.
cues.zh: 需要社會學家或現代歷史學家，幫助我們理解。

cues.en: But we can sort of look at the data and ask questions about the data based on what we see in the visualization.
cues.zh: 但可以先看看資料，根據視覺化看到的情況提出問題。

cues.en: Now, it's not really a fair visualization here because the color scaling is different.
cues.zh: 這裡的視覺化其實不太公平，因為色彩尺度不同。

cues.en: If you wanted to say something more confident about the difference in the correlations of the divorce rates and the marriage rates, it will be helpful to have the color values be the same.
cues.zh: 如果想更有把握地比較離婚率與結婚率的相關差異，讓色彩數值相同會有幫助。

cues.en: So we can change the color values.
cues.zh: 因此，可以改變色彩數值。

cues.en: We can leave the color values for the marriage rates at 0.9 and change the color values for divorce rate data.
cues.zh: 可以讓結婚率的色彩下限保持 0.9，並改變離婚率資料的色彩範圍。

cues.en: But I don't know, I'm a little unsatisfied with that because that saturates everything below 0.9.
cues.zh: 但我不太滿意，因為這會讓所有低於 0.9 的值都飽和。

cues.en: So we're actually losing a lot of information.
cues.zh: 因此，其實會失去很多資訊。

cues.en: A lot of information in this matrix is getting washed out because it's saturated at this really strong correlation.
cues.zh: 這個矩陣的許多資訊都被掩蓋了，因為在這麼高的相關值就達到飽和。

cues.en: So we could try this the other way.
cues.zh: 可以反過來試試。

cues.en: We could set both of them to be 0.7.
cues.zh: 把兩者的下限都設成 0.7。

cues.en: So set the color values to range from 0.7 to 1.
cues.zh: 讓色彩數值範圍從 0.7 到 1。

cues.en: And now you know, now the marriage data is kind of hard to see 'cause everything kind of saturates really close to one.
cues.zh: 現在結婚資料有點難看清楚，因為所有值都在很接近 1 的地方飽和。

cues.en: This is still, I think, more informative than having them both set at 0.9.
cues.zh: 但我認為，這仍然比兩者都設在 0.9 更有資訊。

cues.en: But I don't know, maybe let's try 0.8.
cues.zh: 不過，也許試試 0.8。

cues.en: Let's see if that gives us something interesting.
cues.zh: 看看能不能得到有意思的結果。

cues.en: Okay, so maybe that's a nice balance here.
cues.zh: 或許這裡是個不錯的平衡。

cues.en: We're still saturating a little bit, but it's still pretty visible here and it's not as highly saturated as it was before.
cues.zh: 仍然有一點飽和，但還是看得相當清楚，也不像先前那麼嚴重。

cues.en: Of course, another way to visualize this would be not using matrices, but using plots instead.
cues.zh: 當然，另一種視覺化方式是不使用矩陣，而改用圖表。

cues.en: So we could have scatter plots of all the correlations of marriages and a scatterplot of the correlations of divorce rates, and those would be all in the same plot and easier to visualize the differences.
cues.zh: 可以把所有結婚相關係數的散佈圖，以及離婚率相關係數的散佈圖，放在同一張圖上，更容易看出差異。

cues.en: Okay, but clearly the marriage rates over time across the different states are more stable compared to the divorce rates over the different states.
cues.zh: 不過，顯然各州的結婚率隨時間比較穩定，相較之下，離婚率比較不穩定。

cues.en: And by the way, you can also correlate over states instead of correlating over time the way we did here.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，也可以對州做相關，而不是像這裡一樣對時間做相關。

cues.en: So now I'm creating a different correlation matrix.
cues.zh: 因此，現在我要建立另一個相關矩陣。

cues.en: This is now just for the divorce data.
cues.zh: 這次只用離婚資料。

cues.en: We could also run this again for the marriage data, but this is just for the divorce data.
cues.zh: 也可以對結婚資料再做一次，但這裡只用離婚資料。

cues.en: And now what we see is the correlations over time for each pair of states.
cues.zh: 現在看到的，是每一對州之間，跨時間的相關。

cues.en: So it's interesting that the correlations over the different pairs of years were all generally strongly correlated.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，各對年份之間的相關，整體上都很強。

cues.en: Even here, this goes down to like 0.7 or 0.75 or whatever this was.
cues.zh: 即使這裡，也只降到大約 0.7 或 0.75，或者剛才那個數值。

cues.en: And here, when we correlate over years for each pair of states, we see that some correlations are also really strong, close to 1, and other correlations drop all the way down to 0.
cues.zh: 但這裡，對每一對州跨年份做相關，可以看到有些相關也非常強、接近 1，有些卻一路降到零。

cues.en: So why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Why are some states, why do some states have divorce rates that are strongly correlated with each other and other pairs of states have divorce rates that are weakly
cues.zh: 為什麼有些州的離婚率彼此高度相關，而其他州對的離婚率只有弱相關，

cues.en: or not at all correlated with each other?
cues.zh: 甚至完全不相關？

cues.en: Well, I don't know, but I think it might have something to do with the geography and the location.
cues.zh: 我不知道，但我認為可能與地理位置有關。

cues.en: So I guess I will come up with an hypothesis that the states that are close together, so states that are like physically bordering each other,
cues.zh: 因此，我可以提出一個假設：彼此接近、地理上接壤的州，

cues.en: they are overall, you know, culturally similar and economically similar.
cues.zh: 整體而言在文化與經濟上比較相似。

cues.en: And they may have similar distributions of religious affiliations.
cues.zh: 它們的宗教信仰分布也可能相似。

cues.en: They might have strongly correlated marriage and divorce rates.
cues.zh: 它們的結婚率與離婚率可能高度相關。

cues.en: Whereas states that are further apart from each other, like Oregon and Alabama, those might have divorce rates that are weakly correlated.
cues.zh: 相對地，距離較遠的州，例如奧勒岡與阿拉巴馬，離婚率的相關可能比較弱。

cues.en: Now, that is not an hypothesis that we can test directly with this dataset.
cues.zh: 這不是能用目前這個資料集直接檢驗的假設。

cues.en: However, we could download some extra data.
cues.zh: 不過，可以下載一些額外資料。

cues.en: We could find data for, you know, the longitude and latitude coordinates of the center of each state, and then plot the physical distances
cues.zh: 可以找出各州中心點的經緯度資料，再畫出實際地理距離

cues.en: as a function of these correlation differences and see if my hypothesis is confirmed.
cues.zh: 與這些相關差異的關係，看看我的假設是否獲得支持。

cues.en: Now, I'm not going to do all that.
cues.zh: 但我不打算全部做完。

cues.en: I just want to give you a sense of, you know, what it's like working with real data.
cues.zh: 只是想讓你感受，處理真實資料會是什麼樣子。

cues.en: You make some visualizations and you say, huh, look at that.
cues.zh: 做一些視覺化，然後說：「咦，看看這個。」

cues.en: You know, what is going on with this variability and how can we explain this variability?
cues.zh: 這些變異是怎麼回事？我們要如何解釋它們？

cues.en: So maybe some of this variability in correlations is related to geographical distances between the different states.
cues.zh: 也許，相關係數中的部分變異，與不同州之間的地理距離有關。

cues.en: Okay, so that's enough of the data visualization.
cues.zh: 資料視覺化就先到這裡。

cues.en: In the next video, we are going to get to the inferential statistics.
cues.zh: 下一部影片會進入推論統計。

cues.en: We're finally gonna start doing some computations with P values and Bonferroni corrections T tests, and so on.
cues.zh: 終於要開始計算 P 值、做 Bonferroni 校正、t 檢定等等。
